tests.description: Every test written, each with its file, its name, the one criterion it covers and the assumptions it rests on. Helper files are not listed.

file.description: Path of the test file relative to the working directory.

name.description: The test's full name: the titles of its enclosing groups, such as describe blocks, and its own title, joined by " > ".

criterion.description: The one criterion the test covers: the ID it is marked with.

assumptions.description: IDs of the assumptions this test rests on; empty if it rests on none.
Every decision a test makes that its criterion does not, in English.

id.description: A-001, A-002, … in the order reported.
